ValidationRule.description: Restrict the user from changing the status of closed case for Pin & Selfie Recovery Cases & TrustMe Cases
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c ), ISCHANGED( Status ) , OR( RecordType.DeveloperName == 'PIN_Recovery', RecordType.DeveloperName == 'Selfie_Recovery', RecordType.DeveloperName == 'TrustMe_eIDV_QA_Case', RecordType.DeveloperName == 'TrustMe_eIDV_Case', RecordType.DeveloperName == 'ReKYC_QA_Case' ), IsClosed )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You are not allowed to change the status of a closed case.
